title: Seventy Years of Captivity

questions.question: In what year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, did this word come to Jeremiah? (It was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar).
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 25:1 (ESV): "The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah (that was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon),"

questions.question: For how many years had Jeremiah been persistently speaking the word of the Lord to the people from the thirteenth year of Josiah to that day?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 25:3 (ESV): "For twenty-three years, from the thirteenth year of Josiah... the word of the Lord has come to me, and I have spoken persistently to you, but you have not listened."

questions.question: What had the Lord persistently sent to the people, though they had not listened or inclined their ear?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 25:4 (ESV): "You have neither listened nor inclined your ears to hear, although the Lord persistently sent to you all his servants the prophets,"

questions.question: The prophets said: "Turn now, every one of you, from his evil way and evil deeds, and... in the land that the Lord has given to you and your fathers from of old and forever;"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 25:5 (ESV): "and dwell in the land that the Lord has given to you and your fathers from of old and forever;"

questions.question: "Because you have not heard my words, behold, I will send for all the tribes of the north, declares the Lord, and for Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my..., and I will bring them against this land..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 25:8-9 (ESV): "and for Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant,"

questions.question: For how many years did the Lord say the whole land would become a ruin and a waste, and the nations would serve the king of Babylon?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 25:11 (ESV): "This whole land shall become a ruin and a waste, and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years."

questions.question: "Then after seventy years are completed, I will... the king of Babylon and that nation, the land of the Chaldeans, for their iniquity, declares the Lord, making the land an everlasting waste."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 25:12 (ESV): "Then after seventy years are completed, I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation,"

questions.question: What did the Lord tell Jeremiah to take from His hand and make all the nations to whom he was sent drink it?
options: This cup of the wine of wrath
questions.correctAnswer: This cup of the wine of wrath
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 25:15 (ESV): "Take from my hand this cup of the wine of wrath, and make all the nations to whom I send you drink it."

questions.question: "They shall drink and... and go crazed because of the sword that I am sending among them."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 25:16 (ESV): "They shall drink and stagger and go crazed because of the sword that I am sending among them."

questions.question: Who was the first listed to be made to drink from the cup of the Lord's wrath?
options: Jerusalem and the cities of Judah
questions.correctAnswer: Jerusalem and the cities of Judah
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 25:18 (ESV): "Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, its kings and officials, to make them a desolation and a waste, a hissing and a curse, as at this day;"

questions.question: After all the kings of the north and all the kingdoms of the world drink from the cup, what king will drink after them? (Hint: The name is a cipher for Babylon).
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 25:26 (ESV): "and after them the king of Sheshach shall drink." (Sheshach is an atbash cipher for Babel/Babylon).

questions.question: "Then you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Drink, be..., and vomit, fall and rise no more, because of the sword that I am sending among you.'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 25:27 (ESV): "Drink, be drunk, and vomit, fall and rise no more,"

questions.question: "And if they refuse to accept the cup from your hand to drink, then you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord of hosts: You must...!'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 25:28 (ESV): "Thus says the Lord of hosts: You must drink!"

questions.question: "For behold, I begin to work disaster at the city that is called by my name, and shall you go... ?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 25:29 (ESV): "and shall you go unpunished? You shall not go unpunished,"

questions.question: "Wail, you shepherds, and cry out, and roll in... , you lords of the flock, for the days of your slaughter and dispersion have come, and you shall fall like a choice vessel."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 25:34 (ESV): "Wail, you shepherds, and cry out, and roll in ashes, you lords of the flock,"

key_verse_text: "This whole land shall become a ruin and a waste, and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years."
